criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a render with one hero, 2, 3 and 9 close to the showstopper test. Box-tower skyline, sprite trees on a flat plane, a parapet with no precast texture. Frame 6 about 55 percent defocused murk with bead flies. Frame 4's vial overlaps the page's lines, the page floats on a flat wall.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero, the tape motif changes state, real camera returns. The value strobes with undeclared 4 to 5 and 8 to 9 cuts.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral and drawn count traced, first comment complete, primary sources. The caption opener is an editorial negative, 'Not a certain one' inferred from likely, frame 3 compresses three cohorts, phenotype counts rest on the release, 'Baylor' unqualified.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and a concrete verified next step. Eligibility general, Texas focus unsaid.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, the turn is clear, close actionable. Frames 3 and 5 both evaluate the tool.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, plain, honest, house rules hold. Thin Texas specificity, 'That is not its accuracy.' clipped.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New beat and instrument, no topic repeat. goldenHour, a canvas chart on a kit monitor and the carried-hero structure are familiar.
